reason: License scanning is a lint concern owned by Egolint. Duplicating a license checker in an Aether hook creates two conflicting authorities and obscures the canonical enforcement point. The implementation should be consumed from a stable Egolint command rather than re-implemented here.
safety_concerns: Uses 'git diff HEAD' without verifying clean working tree; diff output is treated as trusted package data.
License lookup shells out to package manager CLIs whose output is not validated before use.
Log directory is created unconditionally and may reveal repository structure in shared environments.
adoption_blocked_by: No ownership in Aether (lint responsibility belongs to Egolint).
No tests or JSON payload fixtures.
No PowerShell parity despite macOS/Linux/Windows claim.
